title: Meal-planner multi-agent
tagline: LangGraph agents write recipes for the meal plan you already follow, check every number in code through nutrition-mcp over MCP, and track meals against it.
summary: You enter the rules of your meal plan once: daily targets, what each meal should be, the gear you own, the time you have and the foods you avoid. The agents write a week of recipes that are all different, nutrition-mcp supplies every nutrition number, and plain Python checks each recipe and day against the plan, sending failures back for a bounded repair. Then it tracks the meals you actually eat, including typed swaps, against your targets.
measures: Share of recipes passing every hard check, single call vs the agent pipeline
